うみちか食堂.name: Umichika Shokudo
うみちか食堂.desc: A local diner in Mashiki, Ginowan City. Reasonably priced, like the Umichika Soba with gentle bonito broth (medium ¥700), with unique menu items such as squid ink soba and bean sprout and garlic chive stir-fry soba. Finishing with zenzai is recommended too.
t: *This article was created with the AI Claude 3.5 Sonnet, with some additions by me.
I ate here in October 2024 😄　This time I'm introducing "Umichika Shokudo" in Mashiki, Ginowan City.
Umichika Shokudo
The exterior is a cream-colored building, marked by a blue sign. Entering the shop, it was bustling with local customers and tourists 😄
Umichika Shokudo's parking lot
Menu
Menu
Menu (set meals are plentiful too)
Menu (there are rice bowls too)

Looking at the menu, starting with the basic "Umichika Soba", there's a rich lineup ranging from standard dishes like soft-bone soki soba and braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) soba to unique items you don't see much at other shops, like squid ink soba and bean sprout and garlic chive stir-fry soba. In terms of price range, you can enjoy Okinawa soba reasonably 😆
This time I decided to order the signature "Umichika Soba (medium)" (¥700).
Umichika Suba (medium)　¥700
The "Umichika Soba" was brought out. First, the clear broth. The gently flavored bonito-stock-based broth comes through.
Umichika Suba (medium)　¥700
The noodles used are a thin straight type. Though the texture is on the soft side, they pair outstandingly with the broth 😋

The braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) topping is slowly simmered to a melt-in-your-mouth texture. The fat has melted out just right and it's delicious, but a little sinewy texture remaining bothered me. The fish cake (kamaboko) has a moist texture, and the aroma of chopped green onions accents the whole thing.

The side menu is also plentiful, and you can enjoy standard Okinawan meals like jushi (Okinawan seasoned rice) and champon too. For dessert there's also "zenzai", unique to Okinawa, which I recommend to finish off 🍨

Rating (9/15): A gently flavored Okinawa soba with a well-balanced broth, plain tasty. The prices are reasonable too, and it's a shop you can drop into casually. When you come to Ginowan City, why not pay it a visit? It was a simple, warm Okinawa soba shop 😊

うむさんの庭.name: Umusan no Niwa
うむさんの庭.desc: An Okinawan charcoal-grill restaurant near Kafuu Resort Fuchaku. The specialty "Charcoal-Seared Thick-Cut Braised Pork Belly Soba" features braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) so tender you can cut it with chopsticks and so fragrant it's No.1 class among all toppings I've had. The lemon-water hospitality is stylish too.
t: I ate here in April 2024 😄
The sign along National Route 58 (turn right at this sign)
Whenever I headed north on National Route 58 in Onna Village (not the bypass, the road along the sea) this sign always caught my eye, so this time I went 😄
"Umusan no Niwa" is near a hotel (Kafuu Resort Fuchaku)
Umusan no Niwa
Right after turning right from the national highway, there was the shop. It's about next door to the hotel.
Umusan no Niwa (apparently an Okinawan charcoal-grill restaurant)
Umusan no Niwa (the entrance is on the 2nd floor, but there are outdoor tables on the 1st floor too. For the evening?)
Umusan no Niwa (the entrance is on the 2nd floor, but there are outdoor tables on the 1st floor too. For the evening?)
Umusan no Niwa (the 2nd-floor entrance)

Entering the shop, I went to the seat the staff guided me to (you're assigned a shoe locker and take your shoes off). There seemed to be a few customers, and it didn't feel crowded. It's a quiet atmosphere inside.
Menu (the touch panel system is nice)
Menu (the touch panel system is nice)

It's a stylish, creative menu of Okinawa soba. All of them look delicious, but I figured the item shown at the very top was probably the recommendation, so I decided to order the "Charcoal-Seared Thick-Cut Braised Pork Belly Soba".
Inside the shop (there were other customers, so sorry, I couldn't photograph the left side, but the shop is spacious)

While waiting, I drank the water in my cup and thought, "? This tastes good somehow." I drank it all and went for a refill from the self-service? water pitcher away from my seat. Then the staff brought a pitcher to my seat, and inside it was lemon 😁
I see, that's why it has a refreshing taste; the lemon flavor is nice too. Stylish right down to the water.
Lemon in the pitcher. Refreshing lemon water, delicious
Charcoal-Seared Thick-Cut Braised Pork Belly Soba　¥1,200
The soba came. First, the broth of course. It's a broth where the bonito stock really comes through, delicious.
Charcoal-Seared Thick-Cut Braised Pork Belly Soba　¥1,200
Next I have the noodles. Apparently they're homemade fresh noodles, and these too are chewy and delicious. Next, the thick-cut braised pork belly (sanmai-niku). And charcoal-seared, no less.

It's a big piece of braised pork belly (sanmai-niku), but when I lift it with my chopsticks, it breaks apart (°°)　It's very tender 😁　And since it's seared over charcoal, it's fragrant and very tasty 😋
I thought it was the most delicious braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) of all the Okinawa soba shops I've eaten at so far. I recommend it.

Rating (12/15): This shop is in a sightseeing spot in Onna Village. The charcoal-seared thick-cut braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) is superb. I thought it was the best of all the Okinawa soba toppings I've eaten so far (as of February 2024). Even the water is lemon water, stylish in a way not found at other shops, so how about trying it once? I recommend it 😄

うるかそば.name: Uruka Soba
うるかそば.desc: A shop in Oroku where you can taste Miyakojima-style soba. A light bonito-based broth, thin noodles, and two large pieces of bone-in pork ribs (hon-soki).
t: I ate here in October 2022 😆
Uruka Soba
Menu
I don't have photos of the inside of the menu, but I ordered the "Hon-Soki Soba". This soba is apparently Miyakojima soba.
Hon-Soki Soba (sorry, I forgot to record the price, so it's unknown)
A sip of the broth. It's a light bonito-based broth with a thin noodle type.
The soki topping is large and there are two pieces in it, but the meat is also the light type 😄 Personally, I'd like it a bit more soaked with flavor lol
Rating (9/15): It feels ordinary. The soki would have been better more soaked with flavor.

うるくそば.name: Uruku Soba
うるくそば.desc: The TOMITON branch, inside the "Okinawa Soba Expo" food court at Toyosaki's TOMITON. Its feature is that you can choose the broth from pork bone or bonito, and the No.1 most popular dish is the sweet-savory soft-bone soki soba. A casual bowl while you're out shopping.
t: This time I went to "Uruku Soba TOMITON branch" inside TOMITON in Toyosaki, Tomigusuku City 😊 I ate here in April 2025 😆
Uruku Soba TOMITON branch
Since it's inside TOMITON, the parking lot is large too, and it's an easy shop to drop into while shopping or out and about.
Menu posted on the wall
Menu posted on the wall
Menu posted on the wall
Sample menu
Sample menu
Sample menu
You can choose the broth from pork bone or bonito 😆

At the shop front, food samples and menus are lined up in a row, and besides Okinawa soba, the menu is quite extensive with set meals, curry, taco rice and more ✨ Families can each order what they like, so my impression was that it seems easy to use.
Looking at the showcase, the one introduced as "Popularity Ranking No.1" was the soft-bone soki soba. Since I was there anyway, this time I tried ordering the popular dish!
This shop's feature is that you can choose the broth from pork bone flavor or bonito flavor. This time, since I like bonito broth, I chose the bonito flavor without hesitation 😊
Soft-bone Soki Soba (bonito broth)　¥700

The soft-bone soki soba that was brought out is a simple bowl with two large soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) on a clear broth. Starting with the broth, the bonito stock comes through more strongly than I expected. The moment it hits your mouth the bonito aroma spreads, and while it's light, I could fully feel the presence of the stock.
Soft-bone Soki Soba (bonito broth)　¥700

The noodles are medium-thick curly noodles. They're boiled on the soft side, with an old-fashioned Okinawa-soba-like texture. Rather than the type where you enjoy firmness, my impression was of gentle noodles you can slurp down smoothly together with the broth.

And the star, the soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki), are well soaked with a sweet seasoning. They're not the fall-apart type, and some parts had a bit of sinewy texture remaining, but when you chew, you can fully taste the savoriness of the pork. With the sweet-savory seasoning, they'd probably go well with rice too 🍖
Overall, it was a well-balanced bowl and plain tasty 😊
However, my honest impression is, "It's tasty, but I think there are other Okinawa soba shops that would move me more~" 😂

Rating (9/15): Plain tasty. The shop is easy to walk into, and being inside a shopping mall, the ease of using it casually is a big draw. I felt it's just the right shop for when you "want to have a quick Okinawa soba" on your way home from shopping or in the middle of sightseeing ✨

うゎちち.name: Wachichi
うゎちち.desc: A popular shop near Okinawa Prefectural Comprehensive Athletic Park. A clear pork bone × bonito broth carefully skimmed so it isn't cloudy, with a choice of noodles (thin curly noodles, etc.). A trio of soy-sauce-soaked pork spare ribs (soki), braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) and soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki).
t: I ate here in January 2023 😄
Wachichi (near Okinawa Prefectural Comprehensive Athletic Park)
I ordered the "Wachichi Soba", which shares the shop's name.
Menu
Wachichi Soba (medium) ¥800
The stock, made from pork bone and bonito flakes, is apparently made with time and effort, carefully skimming the scum without leaving the pot for a moment so the broth doesn't turn cloudy.
First, a sip of the broth. The bonito stock comes across strongly. The noodles are a choose-your-own type, and I picked the commonly ordered "thin curly noodles".

The toppings are pork spare ribs (soki), braised pork belly (sanmai-niku) and soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki), soaked with soy sauce flavor, tender and delicious 😋　I thought the location might be hard to find, but it seems to have been featured on local TV programs too, and it was bustling with customers 😄
Featured on a local TV program
Rating (9/15): Plain tasty.

おおしろそば.name: Oshiro Soba
おおしろそば.desc: Okita, Nago City (moved in 2022). A shop with real skill that many people around me call "the most delicious". It competes with just large, medium and small, with a lettuce topping not found at other shops and a bonito broth, and you can choose flat noodles too. The first shop I visited on my Nago Soba Map tour.
t: It's a shop that people around me call "the most delicious", and it's one of my favorite soba shops too ☺　It's the first shop I visited after deciding to go on a soba tour with the "Nago City Soba Map" lol
It was originally in Gusuku, Nago City, but on November 24, 2022 it moved and reopened in Okita, Nago City, so I went for the first time in a while (December 2022).
"Oshiro Soba", moved and reopened. Apparently it has parking for 9 cars
Oshiro Soba back in its Gusuku, Nago City days before the move (nostalgic 😁)
"Oshiro Soba" introduced as shop 4 of 41 in the "Nago Soba Map"
They compete with just soba (large), (medium) and (small), and I ordered a large ☺
Soba large (350g of noodles) ¥830 (with lettuce, thick fried tofu, fish cake (kamaboko), pork spare ribs (soki), braised pork belly (sanmai-niku))

You can choose regular noodles or flat noodles, and I chose "flat noodles". With a lettuce topping not found at other shops, the bonito broth is as tasty as before the move ✌　The toppings are big-volume too, very satisfying. You can't go wrong.

Rating (12/15): Bonito-based broth is the standard at soba shops in Nago City, but I think Oshiro Soba is delicious, so please give it a try. Before the move it was street parking or a nearby coin parking lot, but now a certain amount of parking (9 cars) is secured, so I think it's easier to drop in than before.

おかあさん.name: Okaasan
おかあさん.desc: A locally popular diner marked by its red sign. A gentle pork-bone-based broth, medium-thick loosely curly noodles, and soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki) with a sweetish soy sauce flavor. A shop featured on Age-Age Meshi, bustling with regulars.
t: *This article was created with the AI Claude 3.5 Sonnet, with some additions by me.
I ate here in September 2024 😄
This time I'm introducing "Okaasan" in Zaha, Itoman City. It seems to be a popular shop loved by locals 🏃‍♂️💨
Okaasan
"Okaasan" is characterized by a simple exterior marked by its red sign. Entering the shop, a warm atmosphere spreads out 😌
Inside the shop
It seems it was featured on a local TV program (Age-Age Meshi)
Menu posted inside the shop
Menu posted inside the shop

Looking at the menu, the standard Okinawa soba dishes are lined up. This time I tried ordering the "Soft-bone Soki Soba". While waiting, seeing it bustling with local customers, I felt firsthand how popular this shop is 👀
Soft-bone Soki Soba　¥900

After a while, the long-awaited "Soft-bone Soki Soba" makes its appearance! 🍜 First, let's taste the broth. The gentle pork-bone-based broth has a flavor that somehow feels nostalgic. It feels plain tasty.
Soft-bone Soki Soba　¥900
Next I have the noodles. The medium-thick loosely curly noodles have a soft-ish texture.

And then the main topping, the soft-bone pork ribs (nankotsu soki). The soy sauce flavor is on the strong side, and a slightly sweet seasoning is characteristic. They're simmered until melt-in-your-mouth, but a little sinewy texture remains.
Looking around the shop, there are many people who seem to be regulars, and the atmosphere is lively. You can really see how it's loved by locals 😊
"Okaasan"'s Okinawa soba doesn't have any particularly unusual features, but its simple, warm flavor is its charm. I feel like I understand why it continues to be loved by locals.
However, if I give my personal impression, the taste struck me as ordinary. It wasn't surprisingly delicious, but there's no doubt it delivers stable deliciousness.
When you visit Itoman City, why not try the Okinawa soba at "Okaasan", loved by locals, at least once? 😉 You're sure to enjoy the simple flavor and warm atmosphere!

Rating (9/15): It feels ordinary 😊　Overall, "Okaasan" delivers stable deliciousness. It's not a surprising taste, but it was a simple, warm Okinawa soba that lets you understand why it continues to be loved by locals. Everyone, please do pay it a visit! 🚶‍♂️🏃‍♀️
